messages:
Olivia: T-minus 3h until the change window. Quick sweep — pin status, smoke owners, rollback trigger thresholds, release notes link. Can we do a rapid confirm? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Matt: On it. I'll pin canary first, warmup, then stable. Posting exact commands as I run them.
Sara: Release notes are live: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v2.3.1 — callouts: kv-cache change, quantization profile updated. Please sanity-check examples.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-21T23:00Z. To pin run: `deploybot pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.1 --target <canary|stable>` (use `--dry-run` to validate).
Matt: Dry-run for canary now: `deploybot pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.1 --target canary --dry-run` — no conflicts.
Matt: Pinning canary: `deploybot pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.1 --target canary`
deploy-bot: success — pinned inference-api:v2.3.1 -> canary (owner: matt).
Kevin: Canary warmup smoke script kicked: `scripts/smoke_inference_canary.sh` running against canary endpoints. I'll post failures if any.
Jing: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards — setting temporary alert: `errors>1.5% OR p95_latency>+50ms` (15m window). I’ll escalate to ops-oncall on trigger.
ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I have the rollback commands ready and will hold the network cut if metrics degrade.
Matt: Canary looks clean after 12 minutes. p95 +8ms, errors 0.2%. Proceeding to stable pin in 5.
Matt: Pinning stable: `deploybot pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.1 --target stable`
deploy-bot: success — pinned inference-api:v2.3.1 -> stable (owner: matt).
Olivia: Nice. Reminder: freeze remains in effect until +4h post-stable pin. No other changes unless emergency.
Sara: Post-deploy smoke checklist: 1) run sample inference for 10 prompt families; 2) run eval regression quickset; 3) sanity-check embedding drift script. Links in release notes.
Kevin: Quick note — we added a fallback routing policy if tokens/timeouts spike: `fallback: model:v2.2.9` (auto for 503s > 5/min). Ops-oncall can flip it manually via the console if needed.
Jing: If alerts fire, initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical routes, 2) enable prefix KV cache bypass, 3) if persists -> rollback to v2.3.0.
Matt: Rollback command (tested): `deploybot rollback --service inference-api --to-version v2.3.0 --reason "auto-rollback-threshold"` — will notify #incidents when executed.
ops-oncall: Confirmed escalation path and Slack runbook. I have runbook link pinned in my view.
Olivia: Everyone, final go/no-go? Reply with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Sara: :thumbsup: verified release notes and config.
Matt: :thumbsup: pins done, monitors green.
Jing: :thumbsup: alerts set, watching.
ops-oncall: :thumbsup: standing by.
Olivia: Go. I’ll post the post-deploy note once we've been stable for 45m. Thank you all. :rocket:
